title: Ramaphosa Pledges 'We Will Do Better' on Xenophobic Violence as 150 Malawian Nationals Repatriated
detail: President Cyril Ramaphosa publicly acknowledged failures in protecting foreign nationals, pledging 'we will do better' on xenophobic violence as another anti-foreigner protest loomed. The statement came amid the repatriation of 150 Malawian nationals who had fled violence. The pledge signals growing pressure on the government to address recurring waves of anti-immigrant sentiment targeting African migrants, particularly in Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal.

media.caption: Ramaphosa pledges action on xenophobic violence as 150 Malawian nationals are repatriated
